speaker: children
text: Where is the grain and wine?
name: The children

speaker: passersby
text: Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of all the earth?
name: Those who pass by

speaker: enemies
text: We have swallowed her up. This is the day for which we have waited. We have lived to see it!
name: The enemies

speaker: poet
text: My strength has perished, along with my hope from the LORD.
name: The poet

speaker: poet
text: therefore I will hope in Him.
name: The poet

speaker: poet
text: We have sinned and rebelled; You have not forgiven.
name: The poet

speaker: poet
text: Do not ignore my cry for relief.
name: The poet

speaker: nations
text: They can stay here no longer.
name: The nations

speaker: people
text: Under his shadow we will live among the nations.
name: The people
